features: Android 14 Smart Projector with Screen Sharing and Live TV: The WZATCO Yuva Spectra Projector runs on Android 14, delivering a smooth and user-friendly smart entertainment experience. Enjoy your favorite movies, shows, and content with ease, or wirelessly share and mirror content from compatible smartphones, tablets, and laptops for a convenient big-screen home cinema experience. With the pre-installed MovieARK Live TV app, you can also access a variety of live TV channels without the need for a separate subscription

13,000 Lumens Brightness with Fully Automatic Setup: Experience bright and immersive visuals with the WZATCO Yuva Spectra's powerful 13,000 lumens (True 300 ANSI) brightness. Its fully automatic setup with Auto Focus and Auto Keystone Correction quickly adjusts the image for a sharp, properly aligned picture with obstacle avoidance and screen adaptation, making setup effortless every time

WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 Connectivity with Dual 5W Speakers: Enjoy fast and stable wireless connectivity with WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0. Connect compatible wireless headphones, speakers, keyboards, and other Bluetooth devices with ease. The built-in dual 5W speakers deliver clear and immersive stereo sound for an enjoyable entertainment experience

Auto Screen Adaptation with 270 Degree Rotatable Design: Enjoy effortless projection with intelligent Auto Screen Adaptation and Auto Obstacle Avoidance. The projector automatically adjusts the image to fit the available screen area while detecting obstacles in the projection path. Its 270 degree rotatable design provides flexible placement and lets you project from different angles with ease

Sealed Optical Engine for Dust Protection and Reliable Performance: The sealed optical engine helps protect the internal optical components from dust, supporting consistent image quality and reliable long-term performance. Designed for everyday home entertainment, the Yuva Spectra combines smart features, powerful brightness, and convenient automatic setup

Native 1080P Resolution with 4K Ultra HD Support: The projector features native 1080P resolution and supports 4K Ultra HD content playback, delivering sharp and detailed images for movies, gaming, and streaming. The high-resolution capability ensures a cinematic viewing experience in the comfort of your home
